_readme: Car specs (app/data/mot_specs.py, eea_specs.py, specs_store.py). Shown as information only: the specs never enter the net calculation. The snapshot (cache/specs-snapshot.json) is made by: python -m scripts.build_specs_snapshot

mot.source: משרד התחבורה, data.gov.il: תוצרים ודגמים של כלי רכב WLTP (מתעדכן כל יום)

eea.source: EEA, CO2 emissions from new passenger cars ([CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars] in discodata). Final data, updated once a year

columns._checked: 2026-10-19 against the API: 'Z (Wh/km)' = electric energy consumption, 'Zr' = electric range (km). There is no 'Electric range (km)' column (error 10003).

fuel.source: US EPA, 'Greenhouse Gas Emissions from a Typical Passenger Vehicle': 8,887 g CO2 per gallon of gasoline = 2,348 g per litre. An approximation: the exact WLTP carbon balance (Regulation (EU) 2017/1151, Annex XXI, Sub-Annex 7) also counts HC and CO, and the test fuel differs. To verify.
fuel.note: Petrol and hybrid only (delek_nm = בנזין). Plug-in: not computed (WLTP CO2 depends on charging). Diesel: no factor, not computed.

indices._note: The data.gov.il field descriptions for these are empty (checked 2026-10-19), so the direction is not documented. 'observed' is what the data suggests, not a source. Unverified -> not used for filtering.

madad_yarok.observed: Range 1-999. Hybrids about 150, Carnival (petrol, large) 374, electric cars empty. Suggests lower = greener

kvutzat_zihum.observed: Range 1-15. Hybrids 3-6, large petrol 15, electric cars empty. Suggests lower = less polluting

nikud_betihut.observed: Range 1-10.5. Kona EV 10.5, Picanto 1. Suggests higher = more safety systems

ramat_eivzur_betihuty.observed: Range 1-8, moves with nikud_betihut. Suggests higher = more safety equipment

knownMissing._note: Catalog cars the source has no rows for (checked 2026-10-19). A test checks every car is found or listed here.
